motion.name: atmosphere-only
motion.value: Gust-driven rose petals, candle flame silhouettes, localized pulsing terrace reflections, faster broader city haze and sky glimmers
motion.purpose: Animate the setting without deforming the figure or dress.

motion.name: default-rate
motion.purpose: Host-controlled requestAnimationFrame clock clamped to 1-60 FPS; elapsed time is accumulated once. Pause, hidden document, reduced motion and speed zero stop the loop.

narrative.overview: This record applies only to this wallpaper theme. A mature adult woman in an opaque asymmetric burgundy evening dress sits on a rose-framed terrace above a fictional twilight city. The mood is restrained fashion glamour; the illustration remains steady while the atmosphere moves.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet atmospheric animation and offline rendering.

rules.name: The Face-Preserving Crop Rule
rules.body: Use a full-viewport cover crop positioned at 66% horizontally and 50% vertically. Desktop retains the quiet city to the left and seated figure to the right; portrait retains the face and most of the seated figure while cropping peripheral scenery.

rules.name: The Stable Figure Rule
rules.body: Keep the face, body and clothing undeformed. Animate the surrounding atmosphere.

dos: Do preserve the mature face and fully clothed fashion presentation.
Do keep motion restrained and respect host lifecycle and reduced motion.
Do retain the prompt and provenance record with the original raster.
donts: Don't add nudity, sexual action, franchise imagery or a HUD.
Don't deform the figure or clothing to create motion.
Don't describe generation provenance as legal clearance.
